caption:
Second place at the Dominical stage of Trilogía — a quiet reminder of what trail running in Costa Rica demands. The coastal humidity of the Southern Pacific is a patient opponent; it waits for you on the first steep climb and stays with you until the finish line. Racing here teaches you to respect the climate long before you respect the elevation. You learn to match your stride to the heavy air, to find a rhythm that doesn't show up on any training plan. The podium is a nice moment, but the real reward is the quiet that comes after a hard day in the hills.
